title: [WT-07] Wrappers: checkpoint landing to the task branch with worktree attribution
description:
Plan against docs/plans/2026-10-30-per-task-worktrees.md §2.4, §2.6 (the pre-push part) and §3.

Objective: every non-completion exit of a worktree-mode worker session lands its bytes on moe/task/<taskId>, never on the target. Attribution inside the private worktree collapses to "every non-DENY dirty path is the task's own".

Deliverable, in scripts/moe-agent.sh and scripts/moe-agent.ps1 as twins:
- Steps L0-L2 of §2.2:
  - the owner guard (landing_owner_guard / Get-MoeOwnerGuard, unchanged; get_commit_scope is used for assigneeProtected only);
  - the W dirty set (`git -C W status --porcelain=v1 -z --untracked-files=all`) minus the worktree DENY variant denied_wt / Test-MoeDenyPathWorktree (today's list, no BOARD tier, plus .claude/skills/**);
  - a temp-index commit with parent T and a CAS of refs/heads/moe/task/<taskId>, then `git -C W reset -q`.
- In worktree mode, no baseline file is written and the PLANNED/MEASURED/PEER/CONTESTED/PREEXISTING tiers are not computed.
- record_commit: kind checkpoint, ref refs/heads/moe/task/<taskId>, empty inferredPaths and unattributedPaths.
- The task branch is pushed per checkpointPush with no force; a rejection is announced and changes nothing. No remote: no push.
- At pre-flight, W dirt left by a crashed session becomes a recovery checkpoint (MOE_CHECKPOINT_RECOVERED).
- A Ctrl+C teardown in worktree mode checkpoints to the task branch or leaves W dirty; it makes no shared-branch rescue.
- Control-checkout seats (architect, QA, governor) land nothing in worktree mode and record MOE_COMMIT_NOTHING_TO_COMMIT.
- Stray edits:
  - the pre-flight writes <gitdir>/moe/worktree/<taskId>.control-dirt;
  - at post-flight, new non-DENY non-.moe dirt in the control checkout prints MOE_WORKTREE_STRAY_EDIT and one add_comment (at most 20 paths);
  - those bytes are never landed and never reverted.
- Cases in scripts/tests/postflight.sh and postflight.ps1. Depends on WT-06 (task-042dc0ddb9b64c60a98a567b71723351).

NOT in scope: completion landing to the target (WT-08/WT-09); the gate (WT-10); the unlanded route and MERGE_HEAD handling (WT-11); board snapshots (WT-12); shared-mode attribution, which must stay unchanged; docs (WT-18).

Verification: node scripts/tests/postflight-safe.mjs bash && bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh (and on a Windows seat: node scripts/tests/postflight-safe.mjs powershell)
definitionOfDone: postflight case (both harnesses): a WORKING exit in worktree mode commits every dirty non-DENY W path to moe/task/<taskId> (parent = previous tip), leaves the target and the control checkout untouched, and records a checkpoint with ref refs/heads/moe/task/<taskId>.

postflight case: DENY paths in W (.mcp.json, .codex/x, .claude/skills link, an untracked .serena file) print MOE_ATTR_EXCLUDED and are not in the commit; no <gitdir>/moe/baseline/<taskId>.tsv is written in worktree mode.
postflight case: W dirt at pre-flight becomes a checkpoint with MOE_CHECKPOINT_RECOVERED; an architect/QA seat exit in worktree mode records MOE_COMMIT_NOTHING_TO_COMMIT.
postflight case: a file the seat writes into the control checkout prints MOE_WORKTREE_STRAY_EDIT, appears in one task comment, and is neither committed nor reverted.
postflight: all existing shared-mode attribution cases pass unchanged; both wrappers carry the same MOE_WORKTREE_/MOE_LAND_/MOE_CONTROL_/MOE_BOARD_ codes (grep -oE diff is empty).
The verification command exits 0; postflight.ps1 passes via node scripts/tests/postflight-safe.mjs powershell.

implementationPlan.description:
sh core helpers (scripts/moe-agent.sh), design §2.2 L0-L2, §2.4, §3.

FIRST read the landed WT-04/05/06 bytes (`git log --oneline --grep 'Moe-Task: task-c20464ff64ca49fca4371dd9b5194364'`, likewise c4cccb84 and 042dc0dd) for three things:
- the per-task workspace variables, proposed in #general msg-ad88dbbd as unexported MOE_WORKSPACE_MODE (shared|worktree), MOE_WORKTREE_PATH (W in the wrapper's own path syntax), MOE_TASK_BRANCH and MOE_LAND_TARGET. Use the names WT-04 actually landed;
- the provisioning success point;
- the postflight worktree fixture.

Editing rule (live seats run this file): write the whole new file elsewhere on the same filesystem, `bash -n` it, then make one `mv -f` over scripts/moe-agent.sh (scripts/CLAUDE.md Hot reload). Define new helpers beside the existing landing helpers, above the main-loop group, never after it.

Add:
(a) A DENY variant as a new MODE `worktree` of resolve_attribution's python. Every snapshot path is a candidate (reason WORKTREE) unless `denied_wt(p, xy)`, which is the existing `denied(p, xy)` OR the path is `.claude/skills` or under `.claude/skills/`. Held paths get MOE_ATTR_EXCLUDED exactly as today. In this mode skip the BOARD sets, scope tiers, baseline/evidence/tool inputs and policy, so .moe/** is always held with no BOARD exception, and write empty unattributed/contested outputs. One denied() list per wrapper stays the single source.
(b) `control_worktree_mode`: rc 0 iff `git -C "$MOE_TOP" symbolic-ref -q HEAD` prints exactly refs/heads/moe/control (the §6.5 invariant WT-04 enforces); any git failure is rc 1.
(c) `land_worktree_checkpoint W BRANCH`. It shadows `local MOE_TOP="$W" MOE_REL="" MOE_GITDIR=$(git -C "$W" rev-parse --absolute-git-dir)`, so git_dirty_snapshot, moe_temp_index_build, write_commit_message, index_refresh, rescue_ref_from_commit and record_commit_rpc run on W unchanged.
- L0: commit_scope postflight, then landing_owner_guard. A refusal goes through landing_refuse_owner: outcome refused, nothing moves.
- L1: git_dirty_snapshot of W, then resolve_attribution worktree, attr_print_skips and today's MOE_ATTR_EXCLUDED count line. No candidates gives outcome nothing with MOE_COMMIT_NOTHING_TO_COMMIT.
- L2: T = `git -C W rev-parse -q --verify refs/heads/$BRANCH`; moe_temp_index_build T (an unchanged tree gives nothing); write_commit_message checkpoint (today's subject and trailers, with ' recovered' when LAND_RECOVERED); `commit-tree -p T`; then ONE `update-ref refs/heads/$BRANCH <new> T`. There is no retry loop: only another session of this task could move it. On success: index_refresh of the landed paths, LAND_OUTCOME=committed, MOE_LANDING_DONE=true.
(d) `push_task_branch BRANCH`, only when CS_CHECKPOINT_PUSH=true. no_git_remote gives today's info line and no push. Otherwise `git -C W push --porcelain origin refs/heads/$BRANCH:refs/heads/$BRANCH`: no force flag, no -u, no MOE_PUSH_REBASE retry. A rejection or failure calls announce_checkpoint_unpushed with the branch, sets pushed=false and changes nothing else.
(e) record_commit_rpc on every outcome: kind checkpoint, ref `refs/heads/$BRANCH` (the full ref, §3.4), paths = the landed set, inferredPaths [] and unattributedPaths [] (present, empty), no contested; pushed is true only for a confirmed push.

Error handling:
- a failed W status gives MOE_COMMIT_FAILED_ATTRIBUTION, recorded failed, W untouched;
- an unresolvable T or a lost CAS gives MOE_COMMIT_FAILED_REF_CONTENTION plus rescue_ref_from_commit 'ref-contention' at the built commit, outcome failed, W untouched;
- an index-build or commit-tree failure follows land_plumbing's existing failure path;
- index_refresh's MOE_COMMIT_INDEX_REFRESH_FAILED warns and never fails the landing.
No path above touches the control checkout, the target or any other ref.
implementationPlan.note: sh core helpers. resolve_attribution gets MODE worktree, defined right after denied(): denied_wt = denied() plus .claude/skills/**, with no BOARD exception. Every other dirty path becomes a WORKTREE candidate, held paths become MOE_ATTR_EXCLUDED skips, and unattributed/contested/missing are written empty with a summary. Added control_worktree_mode (HEAD-only check against refs/heads/moe/control), push_task_branch W BRANCH (git push --porcelain origin refs/heads/B:refs/heads/B with no force/-u/rebase; a failure goes to announce_checkpoint_unpushed) and land_worktree_checkpoint W BRANCH. land_worktree_checkpoint shadows MOE_TOP/MOE_GITDIR to W, then runs the owner guard, the W snapshot, worktree attribution and the existing land_plumbing (temp index from T, commit-tree -p T, CAS update-ref, W index refresh, rescue on contention). When checkpointPush is set it pushes before recording, and it records with ref refs/heads/<branch>. A recovery with nothing to land records nothing. record_commit_rpc sends inferredPaths: [] when MOE_WT_MODE=worktree; shared output is unchanged. Deviation: MOE_REL is not shadowed to "", so a nested project keeps its prefix for DENY and excludePrefixes. Edits use the Edit tool in place: running seats are past the parsed main-loop group, and the TOOL-witness rail wins over the mv recipe. bash -n is OK.

implementationPlan.description:
sh wiring (scripts/moe-agent.sh), using the step-1 helpers.
(a) preflight_landing returns before any baseline, live-marker or baseline-recovery work for a worktree-mode worker (WT-04's mode variable = worktree) and for a non-worker seat while control_worktree_mode. No <gitdir>/moe/baseline/<taskId>.tsv is ever written for them; that file is what the shared recovery, idle recovery and teardown rescue key on, and those would otherwise run ensure_safe_branch (a `git checkout`) in the control checkout. Make sure the mode is known before baseline_write.
(b) Right after WT-04's provisioning succeeds (W/.moe guard passed) and before the CLI launch:
- When CS_AUTO_COMMIT and checkpoints are on (CS_CHECKPOINT_COMMITS=true, MOE_DISABLE_CHECKPOINT!=1), run land_worktree_checkpoint with LAND_RECOVERED=true. On committed, print `MOE_CHECKPOINT_RECOVERED task=<id> sha=<sha>`. Then reset the per-landing globals (LAND_OUTCOME, LAND_SHA, LAND_CODE, MOE_LANDING_DONE, LAND_RECOVERED) so the session's own exit lands normally.
- A failed recovery leaves the dirt in W and the session proceeds.
- A W/.moe guard failure stops the seat before this point, so it makes no recovery commit.
- Then write `$MOE_GITDIR/moe/worktree/<taskId>.control-dirt` (the control's common gitdir): the control checkout's git_dirty_snapshot paths minus denied_wt, so .moe/** is excluded. Write them NUL-separated to a temp file, then mv. A write failure prints one [WARN] and disables the stray check for this session.
(c) Post-flight kind selection, before today's branches. For a worktree-mode worker:
- autoCommit=false: nothing, as today.
- A non-completion exit with checkpoints on: land_worktree_checkpoint, then push_task_branch.
- A non-completion exit with checkpoints off: no landing; W keeps its bytes (one info line).
- A completion exit (REVIEW|DONE): land_worktree_checkpoint for byte safety, then LAND_OUTCOME=failed with `[WARN] worktree completion landing to the target is not available in this wrapper; the bytes are on <branch> and nothing reached <target>`. finalize_postflight then reports failed, never landed; WT-08 replaces this tail.
A worktree-mode exit never calls run_landing, ensure_safe_branch, push_branch or baseline_*.
For ROLE architect|qa while control_worktree_mode: land nothing. Print today's nothing-landed info line with MOE_COMMIT_NOTHING_TO_COMMIT and record_commit_rpc nothing/checkpoint with that code. No run_landing, no ensure_safe_branch, no baseline call. The governor path is unchanged.
(d) teardown_rescue returns early for those same two cases, printing one `[rescue] worktree mode: bytes stay in W for the next pre-flight` line. No rescue_ref.
(e) Stray check after the landing of every worktree-mode worker exit:
- Recompute the control dirt the same way. Paths absent from the pre-flight list print `MOE_WORKTREE_STRAY_EDIT count=<n>` plus up to 5 paths.
- Then send ONE `moe_rpc add_comment {taskId, workerId, content}` naming up to 20 paths (+N more) and saying the bytes were neither landed nor reverted.
- Never stage, land or revert them.
Error handling: a missing or unreadable list, a failed status, or a failed add_comment prints one [WARN] and never changes the landing outcome.
implementationPlan.note:
sh wiring.
(a) preflight_landing returns right after git_top for a worktree worker and for a non-worker seat while control_worktree_mode, so no baseline or live marker is written.
(b) The main flow calls worktree_preflight right after provision_worktree. That is after the W/.moe guard, so a refused seat never recovers. worktree_preflight runs a recovery land_worktree_checkpoint (LAND_RECOVERED=true) when autoCommit and checkpoints are on, prints MOE_CHECKPOINT_RECOVERED on committed or [WARN] on failed (bytes stay in W), then resets LAND_OUTCOME/SHA/CODE/RECOVERED and MOE_LANDING_DONE. A clean W records nothing. It then writes <common gitdir>/moe/worktree/<id>.control-dirt, which worktree_control_dirt builds as the control snapshot minus denied_wt, NUL-separated, written .tmp then mv. A failure prints one [WARN] and MOE_WT_DIRT_LIST stays empty, so the stray check is off. The list is written even with autoCommit=false: stray detection is not a landing. MOE_WT_DIRT_LIST is reset at the loop top.
(c) Post-flight now runs worktree_postflight or control_seat_postflight ahead of today's chain, which becomes elif and is otherwise unchanged.
- worktree_postflight: autoCommit=false gives an info line. A completion (REVIEW|DONE), or checkpoints on, runs land_worktree_checkpoint, which pushes inside when checkpointPush is set. Checkpoints off gives an info line. A completion then prints the exact WT-08 [WARN] and sets LAND_OUTCOME=failed, so finalize never reports landed. worktree_stray_check comes last.
- control_seat_postflight: for architect|qa while control_worktree_mode, prints the info line, records nothing/checkpoint MOE_COMMIT_NOTHING_TO_COMMIT with a fresh ATTR_DIR and no stale tool file, and calls no baseline helper.
(d) teardown_rescue returns early with one [rescue] worktree-mode line for both cases. Its committed-record resend uses refs/heads/<branch> in worktree mode.
(e) worktree_stray_check prints MOE_WORKTREE_STRAY_EDIT count=<n> task=<id> with up to 5 paths, then sends ONE moe_rpc add_comment with up to 20 paths and "+N more". Every failure is one [WARN].
bash -n is OK.

Scope deviation, explained: the WT7A-F scenarios went into the shared suite scripts/tests/postflight-worktree.cjs, not into postflight.sh plus a twin set in postflight.ps1. postflight.sh:969 and postflight.ps1:950 both run that one case list against their own wrapper, so a single set of cases covers both harnesses, and WT-05/06 set this precedent. No counter guard is bumped: the cjs reports its own ok/failed and exits non-zero on any failure, and neither postflight.sh nor postflight.ps1 changed. Existing cases are untouched (DoD 5).

Fixture additions:
- repo() takes {settings}, merged over autoCommit:false.
- launch() takes opts.role and clears .moe/record_commit.jsonl per run.
- The fake CLI honours WT_CLI_WRITE {path: bytes}; a relative path resolves under MOE_WORKTREE_PATH.

New cases:
- wt-checkpoint (WT7A): one commit on the old tip with both files. The target and control (HEAD/sha/index/status) are unchanged. The record deep-equals {committed, checkpoint, ref refs/heads/moe/task/<id>, sha, paths sorted, inferredPaths [], unattributedPaths [], pushed false}. W's index is refreshed.
- wt-deny (WT7B): .mcp.json, .codex/x, .claude/skills/s.md and .serena/f produce MOE_ATTR_EXCLUDED, none of them is in the tree, the bytes stay, and there is no baseline under the control or W gitdir.
- wt-recover (WT7C): a ' recovered' wip on the old tip holds only the leftover file and is the parent of the session checkpoint.
- wt-recover-moe (WT7C negative): with W/.moe present, MOE_WORKTREE_MOE_PRESENT refuses, nothing is recovered, and the dirt and W/.moe/x stay.
- wt-control-seats (WT7D): architect and QA each record exactly one nothing/checkpoint/MOE_COMMIT_NOTHING_TO_COMMIT row. for-each-ref is unchanged, HEAD stays on moe/control, the control write is kept, and no baseline is written.
- wt-stray (WT7E): MOE_WORKTREE_STRAY_EDIT count=1 is printed, and exactly one add_comment names stray.txt and not pre.txt. Neither file is committed on any ref.
- wt-push (WT7F): a local bare origin receives the tip with pushed:true. A forced divergent remote then gives CHECKPOINT-UNPUSHED; the remote keeps the divergent sha, the local branch keeps its new checkpoint on the old tip, and pushed is false.

Result under sh (node postflight-worktree.cjs sh …): 29 ok, 1 failed. The failure is `codes`, expected until step 4 adds MOE_WORKTREE_STRAY_EDIT to ps1.

implementationPlan.description:
ps1 core helpers (scripts/moe-agent.ps1), the twin of step 1, with the same codes and the same behavior. Keep the file UTF-8 with BOM.
(a) `Test-MoeDenyPathWorktree($TopPath,$XY,$Rel,$Settings)` = Test-MoeDenyPath OR a path key equal to `.claude/skills` or starting with `.claude/skills/`. Test-MoeDenyPath already holds .moe/**; the BOARD exception lives only in Resolve-MoeAttribution, which this path never calls.
(b) `Test-MoeControlWorktreeMode`: true iff `git -C <control> symbolic-ref -q HEAD` is exactly refs/heads/moe/control; any failure is false.
(c) `Invoke-MoeWorktreeCheckpoint -TaskId -WorktreePath -Branch -Recovered (+ title, status, cli exit, sid)`, using `$wtGit = @{ Top = W; GitDir = <git -C W rev-parse --absolute-git-dir>; Rel = '' }`:
- Get-MoeOwnerGuard; a refusal goes to Send-MoeOwnerRefusal.
- Get-MoeDirtySnapshot W; null gives MOE_COMMIT_FAILED_ATTRIBUTION.
- Filter with Test-MoeDenyPathWorktree, printing today's MOE_ATTR_EXCLUDED count line.
- Build-MoeTempIndexTree W idx T candidates. Its index file goes under $wtGit.GitDir/moe and is removed in finally.
- New-MoeCommitMessage plus Write-MoeMessageFile, then commit-tree -p T.
- ONE `update-ref refs/heads/<branch> <new> T`. Never Ensure-MoeSafeBranch, never the 3-attempt loop. A lost CAS or unresolvable T gives MOE_COMMIT_FAILED_REF_CONTENTION plus Invoke-MoeRescueRef 'ref-contention' -Sha.
- Then Update-MoeSharedIndex W <landed paths> and $script:moeLandingDone.
It returns Invoke-MoeLanding's result shape (Outcome, Sha, Code, Ref, Pushed, Paths), so Complete-MoePostflight keeps mapping it.
(d) `Push-MoeTaskBranch`: Test-MoeNoRemote first, then an explicit `push --porcelain origin refs/heads/<b>:refs/heads/<b>` with no force and no MOE_PUSH_REBASE. It must never be Push-MoeBranch's bare `git push`, which pushes the current branch of its Top. A failure prints today's CHECKPOINT-UNPUSHED WARN and the #general line.
(e) Send-MoeRecordCommit rows exactly as in step 1(e): full ref refs/heads/<branch>, inferredPaths @(), unattributedPaths @(), no contested.
Error handling mirrors step 1 path for path, with the same codes. Nothing touches the control checkout, the target or any other ref.
implementationPlan.note:
ps1 core helpers placed before Invoke-MoeRecoveryCheck:
- Test-MoeControlWorktreeMode
- Test-MoeDenyPathWorktree (Test-MoeDenyPath plus .claude/skills/**)
- Get-MoeWorktreeAttribution

Splitting out Invoke-MoeWorktreeCommit keeps the functions shorter.

The ps1 helper uses the control Rel, not '', to mirror sh, where MOE_REL is not shadowed. Record paths therefore stay ROOT-relative.

sh fixes made in this step:
- land_plumbing now honours LAND_ONE_CAS=true: one attempt, no rebuild echo, shared behaviour unchanged. This meets the plan's ONE update-ref requirement.
- If T does not resolve, the result is MOE_COMMIT_FAILED_REF_CONTENTION and the bytes stay in W. There is no commit to rescue in that case, so no rescue ref is written. The same rule is in both twins.

implementationPlan.description:
ps1 wiring (scripts/moe-agent.ps1), the twin of step 2.
(a) Invoke-MoePreflightBaseline returns before Invoke-MoeRecoveryCheck, Write-MoeBaseline and Write-MoeLiveMarker for a worktree-mode worker (WT-04's $script: mode variable) and for an architect/QA seat while Test-MoeControlWorktreeMode. No baseline file is ever written for them.
(b) Right after WT-04's provisioning success point and before the CLI launch:
- Run the recovery checkpoint (-Recovered) when autoCommit and checkpoints are on; print `MOE_CHECKPOINT_RECOVERED task=<id> sha=<sha>` on committed.
- Reset $script:moeLandingDone and the landing result so the session's own exit lands.
- Then write the control-dirt list ($moeGit.GitDir/moe/worktree/<taskId>.control-dirt: control dirt minus Test-MoeDenyPathWorktree, NUL-separated, temp file then Move-Item -Force).

- Non-completion with checkpoints on: Invoke-MoeWorktreeCheckpoint, then Push-MoeTaskBranch when $moeSettings.checkpointPush.

implementationPlan.description:
postflight.ps1 scenarios (scripts/tests/postflight.ps1): the twins of step 3's WT7A-WT7F, with the same names, the same assertions and the same fixtures.
- Build on the landed WT-04/05/06 worktree fixture in this harness; add a small New-WtProject beside New-ScopeProject only if it is missing.

Verification, once, from the repo root. This is the exact command, and its fresh output is complete_task's evidence:
node scripts/tests/postflight-safe.mjs bash && bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh && diff <(grep -oE 'MOE_(WORKTREE|LAND|CONTROL|BOARD)_[A-Z0-9_]*' scripts/moe-agent.sh | sort -u) <(grep -oE 'MOE_(WORKTREE|LAND|CONTROL|BOARD)_[A-Z0-9_]*' scripts/moe-agent.ps1 | sort -u)
It must exit 0, with postflight-safe failureClass NONE and parity PASS (DoD 5, 6).

Windows evidence (DoD 6): run `node scripts/tests/postflight-safe.mjs powershell` on a Windows seat. From WSL, use the Serena gotcha-qa-ps1-postflight-from-wsl recipe: a Windows-drive cwd, env -u for every MOE_*/CLAUDE* var, and MOE_POSTFLIGHT_TIMEOUT_SEC=180. Record which engine ran. Do not count pwsh alone as Windows PowerShell 5.1 evidence.

Then measure the task-wide non-board diff over the 4 files: this task's checkpoint commits plus the working tree, `git diff --numstat <parent of this task's first commit> -- <files>`. If it exceeds 400 net changed lines, file a size exception BEFORE complete_task: moe.propose_rail {proposalType:'ADD_RAIL', targetScope:'EPIC', taskId, ...}.
- Word it like prop-d975cf4e: per-file +/-, runtime vs tests, 'grow it only by defect fixes QA requires; it waives size only; every DoD item and fresh verification still apply'.
- Its reason: the DoD binds L0-L2, DENY, recovery, the control-seat rule and stray edits to this one row in both twins and both harnesses. Agents cannot edit a DoD, so a split would loop back to PLANNING.
- Name the proposal id in the completion summary.

implementationPlan.note: Adversarial self-review of the diff in these 3 paths (git diff -- <paths>). One real defect found and fixed in both twins: a worktree COMPLETION exit interrupted after the branch CAS (during the push or ledger record, before worktree_postflight's tail) could finalize_attempt 'landed'. The checkpoint is not a landing; WT-08 lands the target. Fix: the MOE_WT_COMPLETION / $script:MoeWtCompletion flag is set in worktree_postflight / Invoke-MoeWorktreePostflight. finalize_postflight / Complete-MoePostflight then map 'committed' to failed, not landed, when the flag is set, and the loop top resets the flag. Added the cjs case wt-completion (FAKE_TASK_STATUS=REVIEW): the checkpoint is on moe/task/<id> with parent main, main is unmoved, the completion WARN is printed, and the finalize outcomes are ['failed']. It passes on sh and ps1. Earlier in this task I also fixed an unresolvable task-branch tip: with no tip it now refuses as MOE_COMMIT_FAILED_REF_CONTENTION and the bytes stay in W, where before it would have made an orphan commit from an empty tree. Checklist: (1) concurrency: a single update-ref CAS (LAND_ONE_CAS). A moved tip is never rebased; it goes to a rescue ref (wt-contention case). The control-dirt list is written to .tmp then mv'd. (2) inputs: paths are NUL-separated or -z, pathspecs are :(literal), and the stray list is capped at 5 printed / 20 commented. (3) assumptions: the owner guard runs first, and a missing W/branch never builds an orphan. (4) exit paths: temp index and msg removed on every path (sh trap/rm, ps1 finally). A ps1 committed row is re-sent in finally if not recorded. Teardown in worktree mode makes no rescue ref; the bytes stay in W. (5) Theoretical, noted for QA: a human edit in the control during a session is flagged as a stray edit (by design, comment only, never reverted). .serena/ is gitignored, so it is not flagged. The interrupt-after-CAS path is covered by the code fix but not harness-driven. Idle recovery across a mode switch is WT-13. Bytes changed, so I re-ran step 7's exact command fresh: it printed {"engine":"bash","exit":0,"lastScenario":"Z","failureClass":"NONE","failureLine":null} and PASS parity-check.sh, and the diff was empty, rc 0. Windows `postflight-safe.mjs powershell` printed {"engine":"powershell","exit":0,...,"failureClass":"NONE"}, rc 0. executionContract.intendedBehavior: In worktree mode, every non-completion exit of a worker session commits every non-DENY dirty path of its task worktree W onto refs/heads/moe/task/<taskId> (temp index, commit-tree -p T, one update-ref CAS, W index refresh). It writes no baseline, computes no attribution tiers, records a checkpoint with the full task-branch ref and empty inferred/unattributed paths, and pushes the task branch without force when checkpointPush is on. A dirty W at pre-flight becomes a recovery checkpoint (MOE_CHECKPOINT_RECOVERED), but only after WT-04's W/.moe guard passes. Teardown makes no shared rescue. Architect/QA seats whose control checkout is on refs/heads/moe/control land nothing (MOE_COMMIT_NOTHING_TO_COMMIT). New control-checkout dirt made during a worker session is reported once (MOE_WORKTREE_STRAY_EDIT plus one add_comment) and never landed or reverted. Shared mode is byte-for-byte unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: WT7A: a worktree WORKING exit adds one commit on moe/task/<id> (parent = previous tip) holding the dirty paths; target and control checkout unchanged; record {committed, checkpoint, refs/heads/moe/task/<id>, paths, inferredPaths [], unattributedPaths []}.
WT7B: DENY paths in W (.mcp.json, .codex/x, .claude/skills, untracked .serena) print MOE_ATTR_EXCLUDED and stay out of the commit; no baseline file exists.
WT7C: leftover W dirt becomes a ' recovered' checkpoint with MOE_CHECKPOINT_RECOVERED before the session's own checkpoint; with W/.moe present no recovery commit is made.
WT7D: architect and QA exits with the control on moe/control record MOE_COMMIT_NOTHING_TO_COMMIT and move no ref.
WT7E: a control-checkout write prints MOE_WORKTREE_STRAY_EDIT and produces one add_comment, never committed or reverted; pre-existing control dirt is not reported.
WT7F: the task branch pushes without force; a divergent remote prints CHECKPOINT-UNPUSHED and changes no ref.
Existing shared-mode scenarios pass unchanged; MOE_WORKTREE_/LAND_/CONTROL_/BOARD_ code sets are equal across sh and ps1; the verification command exits 0; postflight.ps1 passes on Windows.
invariants: A worktree-mode exit never calls run_landing/Invoke-MoeLanding, ensure_safe_branch/Ensure-MoeSafeBranch, push_branch/Push-MoeBranch or a baseline helper.
No worktree-mode path moves the target, the control checkout's HEAD or index, or any ref except refs/heads/moe/task/<id> and refs/moe/rescue/<id>/*.
A worktree completion exit never finalizes 'landed' before WT-08.
.moe/** in W is always held (no BOARD exception); stray control bytes are never staged or reverted.
compatibility: Shared mode, its record_commit rows (short branch ref) and every existing harness scenario stay byte-identical.
Uses WT-04's per-task workspace variables and provisioning success point as landed (proposed names in msg-ad88dbbd).
Exposes land_worktree_checkpoint / Invoke-MoeWorktreeCheckpoint, push_task_branch / Push-MoeTaskBranch and control_worktree_mode / Test-MoeControlWorktreeMode for WT-08..WT-13.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
- (1) Reuse run_landing / Invoke-MoeLanding with a worktree flag. Rejected. Both hard-wire the control checkout: ensure_safe_branch / Ensure-MoeSafeBranch run `git checkout` there, the CAS ref is refs/heads/$LAND_BRANCH, and baseline and tiers are threaded through every branch. A compact arm that reuses the low-level helpers (snapshot, temp-index build, message, record, rescue-from-commit, index refresh) stays smaller and cannot regress shared mode (rail 4).
- (2) A third copy of the DENY list for denied_wt. Rejected. sh gains a resolve_attribution MODE worktree that calls the existing denied() plus the .claude/skills rule; ps1 wraps Test-MoeDenyPath. Each wrapper keeps one list.
- (3) Reading settings.worktreeMode for control seats. Rejected: the daemon default lives only in resolveWorktreeMode (WT-19 flips it), and a non-WORKING claim's workspace always says shared. HEAD == refs/heads/moe/control is the §6.5 invariant WT-04 enforces; it is local and needs no daemon change.
- (4) Leaving worktree completion exits to WT-08. Rejected: they would fall into the shared landing and git checkout the control off moe/control. WT-07 commits their bytes to the task branch and fails the completion explicitly, never 'landed'.
- (5) A teardown test. Skipped: teardown is inert without a baseline file (existing teardown-no-baseline mode), and WT7B proves no baseline exists in worktree mode; the explicit early return is reviewed in step 8.
- (6) Splitting the row. Not possible without a DoD edit (agents cannot edit DoD), so it is planned whole with a measured size exception.
